goal: Create Low Poly Character Studio: review markers, generate a model, rig and animate it, validate and export a GLB.

changes.proposed_content:
{
  "name": "low-poly-character-studio",
  "private": true,
  "packageManager": "pnpm@9.15.9",
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=22 <23"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "studio": "bash scripts/dev.sh",
    "studio:ui": "pnpm --filter @low-poly-character-studio/style-studio dev",
    "studio:build": "pnpm --filter @low-poly-character-studio/style-studio build",
    "studio-responsive:test": "pnpm --filter @low-poly-character-studio/api exec tsx --test ../../apps/style-studio/src/responsive-studio.test.ts ../../apps/style-studio/src/product-responsive-reflow.test.ts ../../apps/style-studio/src/studio-simplification.test.ts",
    "model-types:test": "pnpm --filter @low-poly-character-studio/api exec tsx ../../packages/model-types/test/registry.test.ts",
    "pipeline-contracts:test": "pnpm --filter @low-poly-character-studio/api exec tsx ../../packages/pipeline-contracts/test/artifacts.test.ts",
    "manifest-compiler:test": "python3 packages/asset-compiler/compiler/test_manifest_contract.py",
    "manifest-compiler:smoke": "bash scripts/run-manifest-compiler-smoke.sh",
    "semantic-analysis:test": "pnpm --filter @low-poly-character-studio/api exec tsx ../../packages/reference-analysis/test/index.test.ts",
    "build-jobs:test": "pnpm --filter @low-poly-character-studio/api test:build-jobs",
    "reference-analysis:test": "pnpm --filter @low-poly-character-studio/api exec tsx ../../apps/style-studio/src/reference-analysis.test.ts",
    "animation-catalog:test": "pnpm --filter @low-poly-character-studio/api exec tsx --test ../../apps/style-studio/src/AnimationClipCatalog.test.ts",
    "vertical-slice:test": "pnpm --filter @low-poly-character-studio/api exec tsx --test ../../apps/style-studio/src/vertical-slice-readiness.test.ts ../../apps/style-studio/src/vertical-slice-build-workflow.test.ts",
    "pipeline-runner:test": "pnpm --filter @low-poly-character-studio/api test:pipeline-runner",
    "final-workflow:test": "pnpm --filter @low-poly-character-studio/api exec tsx --test ../../apps/style-studio/src/final-build-workflow.test.ts && pnpm vertical-slice:test && pnpm pipeline-runner:test && pnpm studio-responsive:test && pnpm marker-review:test",
    "model-runner:test": "pnpm --filter @low-poly-character-studio/api test:model-runner",
    "rig-runner:test": "pnpm --filter @low-poly-character-studio/api test:rig-runner",
    "animation-runner:test": "pnpm --filter @low-poly-character-studio/api test:animation-runner && pnpm --filter @low-poly-character-studio/api test:final-artifact",
    "final-artifact:test": "pnpm --filter @low-poly-character-studio/api test:final-artifact",
    "animation-pack:test": "python3 packages/asset-compiler/blender/tests/test_animation_pack.py",
    "blender:setup": "bash scripts/setup-blender.sh",
    "rig-review": "bash scripts/render-rig-review.sh",
    "style-dna:test": "python3 packages/asset-compiler/blender/tests/test_style_dna.py",
    "dev": "bash scripts/dev.sh",
    "api": "pnpm --filter @low-poly-character-studio/api dev",
    "marker-review:test": "pnpm --filter @low-poly-character-studio/api exec tsx --test ../../apps/style-studio/src/marker-review.test.ts"
  }
}
